'''''Raven''''' was a group of siz [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|escort shuttles]] used by the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]]. They were used in the final stage of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Sepan campaign|campaign]] to end the [[Sepan Civil War]]. Launching from the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] ''[[Shemsher]]'' to interfere with the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector's'']] retrieval of [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] from [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort Carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]''. The Escort shuttles were destroyed in the battle.
